I love the entire way Prime is supposed to work, but after reading many experiences like mine for different reasons, the problem remains the same. I have a feeling that one day the wheels may really fall off at AMAZON, the customer service here is like the way big banks used to be - TOO BIG TO FAIL...

Cant put my finger on I but one suggestion I have is to try hiring more AMERICANS that speak english so we can all understand the conversation. I have had to hang up on their Customer Service Reps on several calls, simply because I was frustrated saying the same thing over and over again, after requesting a different rep that speaks understandable English. Needless to say, I'm not renewing prime this year (2019). Ill review the customer service threads to see if they are taking our reviews more seriously.

eBay, Im on my way back for 2019. Amazon needs some serious attention in learning more about the problems so they dont keep happening...
